title: 394. Remove Invalid Parentheses

examples.explanation: Removing one bracket yields two balanced variants.
The letter is fixed; one bracket is dropped two ways.
Nothing balanced remains except the empty string.

hints: Breadth-first removal level by level guarantees the first balanced strings found use the fewest deletions.
Only ever delete bracket characters; letters are part of every candidate.
Skip deleting a bracket identical to its left neighbour to avoid repeat candidates.
